description: We Did It! I am so proud and honored to announce that I have been re-elected into Colorado’s State House of Representatives for HD 23!I am so appreciative and thankful for every volunteer, voter, and grassroots supporter who made tonight possible. I am also very grateful for all of my staff -especially my campaign manager Emily Funk- who helped make this day possible!While I am extremely grateful to be elected to represent my community for two more years, I know we have a lot more work ahead of
